text:
Raj: thinking about a compact 'delta cost' peek on the route card that shows marginal (post-cache) next to baseline. aim is to let engineers pick canary splits with cost signal visible.
Mei: love it. can we keep the default view conservative (amortized) and surface marginal only when users opt in? worried about confusing billing teams.
Jordan: question on data model: do we treat shared prefetch credits as first-touch (origin) or proportional split? first-touch is simpler but skews owners who prefetch.
infra-bot: dag created: cost_rollup_delta_v2 (status: queued) :package:
Priya: operationally I'd prefer proportional split within session window. simplest heuristic: if cache_key used by >1 route within 10m session, allocate credits by token share. fallback to origin for single-use keys.
Raj: that matches our earlier conversations. Mei: sampling idea for live panels: keep full hourly aggregates, but for the live 'peek' use a small reservoir sample keyed by route+model to estimate marginal at low latency.
Tomas: reservoir sample is doable; we need to expose sample_rate on the panel and surface an annotation when sample < 1%. also include 'estimated error +/-'.
Jordan: quick SQL to illustrate hourly rollup (naive):
```sql
SELECT route, model_sku, date_trunc('hour', ts) hr,
       SUM(tokens) total_tokens,
       SUM(token_cost_raw) total_cost,
       SUM(cache_credit) total_cache_credits,
       (SUM(token_cost_raw)-SUM(cache_credit))/NULLIF(SUM(tokens),0) AS marginal_per_token
FROM token_events te
LEFT JOIN cache_events ce ON te.request_id = ce.request_id
WHERE ts >= now()- interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route, model_sku, hr;
```
Mei: that works for rollups. for realtime UI we'll stream sampled events into a small materialized view and compute attribution there.
Priya: cost of extra rollups? can we limit hourly rollups to top N routes by spend and keep sampled rollups for others? that saves pipeline $$. 
Raj: agreed. proposal: top 500 routes full hourly rollups, sampled (1%) for remainder with higher-latency full backfill nightly. document behavior clearly in the console tooltip.
Tomas: UX note: show a small status pill: 'marginal: sampled (1%), est err ±3%' or 'marginal: computed (hourly)'. clickable to show provenance.
Jordan: edge case: multi-model chains where early model expands tokens for downstream model. marginal per-model attribution should optionally include 'chain-adjusted' mode that accounts for generated tokens. default off.
Mei: can someone add a flag and an experiment id so we can measure support queries and misinterpretation? Raj: I'll own the rollout flag and tracking.
infra-bot: experiment created: delta_cost_peek_v1 (flag: eng-platform) :white_check_mark:
Priya: I'll update docs to add an example explaining proportional split vs origin attribution and a short FAQ.
Raj: action items: Tomas -> UI microcopy + status pill, Mei -> sampling pipeline PR, Jordan -> rollup SQL + backfill job, Priya -> docs, I'll own rollout and metrics.
Mei: thanks, will start the telemetry ticket and post perf numbers once sampling probe runs.
Tomas: posting a quick mock in #design in a bit.
Raj: great. closing the thread unless objections.
